button.confirm: The AI assistant rewrites the analysis and replaces its suggestions and risks that are still undecided. Anything people wrote or decided is kept. Continue?

button.name: action_ai_suggest
button.help: The AI assistant suggests campaigns from the brand profile, goals and latest research. Nothing is sent or published.

group.div: The assistant reads the brand profile, goals and latest research, and suggests up to four campaigns with risks. It only sees this brand profile, goals, approved competitors and the run's findings. It cannot send, publish or spend anything.
